title.zh: v2.0.74 踩镲的金属簇不再叠 6 个振荡器：一条可测的平台规律，以及一次自我更正
title.en: v2.0.74 The Hi-Hat Cluster Stops Summing Six Oscillators: a Measurable Platform Rule, and a Self-Correction

highlights.zh: **起因**：重新录 timbre 基线时发现 `chicago-house` 的重复渲染偏差是 **1.317 dB**，而门禁脚本的头注释声称导出器逐位可复现（0.000014 dB）。追下去发现一条**平台层面可测的规律**：**一个 Web Audio 节点上叠加 3 个及以上「频率各不相同」的振荡器时，Chrome 的 `OfflineAudioContext` 每次渲染结果都不同**；同频振荡器可以、buffer 源可以、每节点最多 2 个可以。本项目的踩镲金属簇正是 6 个方波振荡器，而 `[310,387,466,522,681,1070]` 恰好落在观测到差异的频段 6–10。
highlights.en: **How it started**: re-recording the timbre baseline showed `chicago-house` at a **1.317 dB** repeat drift, while the gate script's own header claimed the exporter was bit-reproducible (0.000014 dB). Chasing it produced a **measurable platform rule**: **a Web Audio node summing three or more oscillators tuned to different frequencies renders differently every time in Chrome's `OfflineAudioContext`** — same-frequency oscillators are fine, buffer sources are fine, and two per…

highlights.zh: **修法：把分音烘焙成一个 buffer**。新增 `inharmonicClusterBuffer()`，用奇次谐波 1/n 展开还原方波，所以音色不变；音高改由 `playbackRate` 承载（打击乐各族的 `mult` 正好是整体移调）。接入踩镲金属簇、打击乐 metal 族、铃鼓 jingle 层。两处不能烘焙的改为**树状扇入**：膜鸣族（timbale，3 个分音各有独立衰减与音高下滑，烘焙会丢掉「Defect B」的逐分音包络）用 (2+1) 树；`kick:*` 模拟底鼓（`somatic-808-gravity` 四层全开）用 2+2 树。参数一字未改。
highlights.en: **The fix: bake the partials into one buffer.** New `inharmonicClusterBuffer()` renders a square partial as its odd harmonics at 1/n, so the timbre is unchanged, and the pitch lane moves to `playbackRate` (the percussion families' `mult` is exactly a whole-cluster transposition). Wired into the hi-hat cluster, the metal percussion family and the tambourine's jingle layer. highlights.zh: **顺带的收益与守卫**：每次踩镲少 6 个振荡器、每个金属族打击乐少 3 个——踩镲是 pattern 里最密的声部。新增 `oscillatorFanIn.test.ts`，对全部鼓件、全部 16 个打击乐模型、全部 `kick:*` 预设断言「同一节点首次混合的异频振荡器 ≤2」（它在修复前会失败，实测报出 12 条违规）；`drumFidelityTier1` 里补了 **Goertzel 频谱断言**（每个分音的基频与三次谐波都有能量、非谐波频点没有），防止这次改动把 Q4 的金属簇悄悄变成静音缓冲。
highlights.en: **The side benefits and the guard**: six fewer oscillators per hi-hat hit and three fewer per metal percussion hit, on the densest voice in the pattern. New `oscillatorFanIn.test.ts` asserts, for every drum voice, every one of the 16 percussion models and every `kick:*` preset, that a node mixes at most two differently-tuned oscillators for the first time (it fails against the old code — 12 violations, measured); and `drumFidelityTier1` gains a **Goertzel spectrum assertion*…
